methodology: Articles sourced from Virginia-specific RSS feeds and Google News RSS, filtered for AI/technology/workforce relevance, then assessed by Claude against the scenario framework. Each article is tagged with the region it most affects and the scenario it signals toward.

signals.title: AI pressure grows on Richmond's young workforce - Axios
signals.signal_reading: Young Richmond workers facing AI pressure signals broad but shallow adoption driven by platform tools that increase workplace anxiety without building deep technical capability or AI fluency across the workforce.

signals.title: Virginia Beach schools bring ChatGPT under division oversight as AI use grows - 13newsnow.com
signals.signal_reading: Virginia Beach schools deploying ChatGPT under division oversight represents platform-delivered AI creating distributed access, but institutional control over commercial tools suggests shallow adoption rather than building indigenous AI development capacity.

signals.title: Norfolk could get AI assist for non-emergency calls - WAVY.com
signals.signal_reading: Norfolk's AI dispatcher for non-emergency calls exemplifies shallow, distributed adoption through vendor-supplied platforms that automate tasks without developing local AI expertise or creating pathways to deeper technical capability.

signals.title: Fairfax City Business Leaders Tell Spanberger About Rising Costs, AI, Workforce Challenges - Patch
signals.signal_reading: Fairfax business leaders discussing AI alongside workforce challenges indicates concentrated capability in NoVA's tech hub where AI is an operational reality rather than an aspiration, widening the gap with regions where AI remains abstractly future-facing.

signals.title: Learning Law in the AI Age - University of Virginia School of Law
signals.source: University of Virginia School of Law
signals.signal_reading: UVA Law School integrating AI into legal education represents elite institutions building deep capability that concentrates expertise in metro-adjacent universities rather than distributing AI fluency through community colleges or vocational programs across rural Virginia.
